gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.696429 40.238092)',4326)::geography, 3000)
    AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 80;

WITH caverns_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-83.696429, 40.238092), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
cafes_within_distance AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM pois p, caverns_geom c
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, c.geom, 3000)
    AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
),
elevation_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             rast,
             true,
             ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(c.geom, 32616), 5000) -- buffer to ensure full raster coverage
           ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us, caverns_geom c
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(c.geom, 32616))
),
cafes_with_elevation AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM cafes_within_distance c
  JOIN elevation_clip e
    ON ST_Contains(ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(e.clipped_rast), 4326), c.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE ST_Value(e.clipped_rast, c.geometry::geometry) <= 80
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cafe_count
FROM cafes_with_elevation;
